purpose: Versioned operational specifications for every active curation policy. These cards define reproducible trigger boundaries, not intrinsic Quality judgments.

cards.hypothesis: A distinct valid chunk is positively retention-eligible only when the routing precondition and both independent Quality evidence heads pass frozen route-scoped boundaries.
cards.deployment_scope: registered observable content routes with complete frozen evidence bundles
forbidden_inputs: route label as standalone Quality evidence
negative_conditions: a route label without both external evidence heads abstains
a bundle for a route not assigned by the router abstains
mixed unknown and out-of-distribution routing abstains
an indeterminate missing or out-of-scope head abstains
a below-positive score without a named negative boundary cannot reject
cards.coverage_impact: candidate decisions are reported by route status; Coverage cannot change a Quality decision or threshold
cards.rollback_behavior: remove the incomplete route bundle and return to abstain-retain without changing the active Stage-C policy

cards.hypothesis: A provider evidence bin may support retention or non-selection only when preregistered rule-on-off measurements reproduce the same effect direction on disjoint development and held-out data with explicit uncertainty.
cards.decision_unit: distinct Validity-passing chunk mapped to one frozen provider evidence bin
cards.deployment_scope: candidate-only registered Quality providers and routes with completed calibration gates
allowed_inputs: routing state and routed content route
negative_conditions: audit-only calibrated development or confirmatory providers abstain
mixed unknown and out-of-distribution routes abstain
a provider identity change invalidates inherited calibration
a provider cannot contribute evidence to an unsupported route
sensitivity arms with different or overlapping baselines invalidate calibration
a bin with either interval crossing zero abstains
held-out nonmonotonicity or interval mismatch blocks the complete calibration
provider output without policy-level causal evidence cannot reject
cards.coverage_impact: candidate nonpositive decisions remain non-mutating until Coverage can veto support extinction and choose representatives
cards.rollback_behavior: discard the provider calibration and return every model-based Quality observation to abstain-retain

cards.hypothesis: A proposed subset must preserve at least one eligible representative for every supported stable or uncertain stratum, while redundancy-family representatives should maximize frozen facility-location support.
cards.decision_unit: proposed subset over one frozen Validity-passing universe
cards.deployment_scope: candidate-only frozen support strata and semantic-provider evidence
allowed_inputs: chunk identifier and tokenizer-count token mass
stable support and uncertain intersection strata
independent typed Validity evidence or complete five-hash calibrated negative-Quality trace
negative_conditions: an audit-only or identity-mismatched semantic provider abstains
a provider output cannot directly remove a chunk
all-member independent exclusion evidence permits but does not require stratum extinction
fixed quotas and source metadata cannot alter protection
a single scalar cannot replace the vector Coverage report
cards.coverage_impact: emits nonmutating veto candidates, family representatives, support recall, token shift, divergence, radius, and effective sample size
cards.rollback_behavior: discard semantic candidate evidence and retain the existing active representative-linkage materialization invariant

cards.hypothesis: Closed integrity evidence should trigger deterministic repair or context-preserving rechunking before quarantine, and rejection should require absence of interpretable payload after recovery.
cards.deployment_scope: all text inputs under the registered explicit structural guard
allowed_inputs: exactly one declared text field or raw bytes with declared encoding
negative_conditions: clean interpretable payload passes without intervention
mathematical angle notation is retained
excess structural closers alone are retained
ambiguous control characters are never guessed into punctuation
a structural chunk defect cannot authorize rejection when source-record context is unavailable
cards.coverage_impact: no selection authority; repair and rechunk preserve original text hashes, while quarantine and reject remain separate dispositions
cards.rollback_behavior: preserve the immutable original and disable candidate recovery without altering the active Stage-A output

cards.hypothesis: A training candidate must expose source identity, URI, and collection time.
cards.deployment_scope: all declared input sources
negative_conditions: all required provenance fields are declared
cards.coverage_impact: none
cards.rollback_behavior: quarantine only; repair upstream manifest and rerun

cards.hypothesis: Declared risk signals require quarantine rather than a training release decision.
cards.deployment_scope: all declared input sources
negative_conditions: no declared rights or hazard signal is present
cards.coverage_impact: none; quarantine is not a domain-mix decision
cards.rollback_behavior: retain quarantined artifact and revise only a declared detector or source context

cards.hypothesis: Only a closed text-validity failure may quarantine a source-agnostic candidate.
cards.deployment_scope: all declared input sources
negative_conditions: short but interpretable text is retained
unfamiliar format is retained
partial examples are retained
cards.coverage_impact: none
cards.rollback_behavior: quarantine only; correct normalizer or upstream encoding and rerun

cards.hypothesis: Repository-code line endings and a leading UTF-8 BOM can be normalized without selection.
cards.deployment_scope: sources declaring pii_context=repository_code
negative_conditions: non-repository sources do not use this normalization branch
cards.coverage_impact: none
cards.rollback_behavior: disable transformation and preserve original input

cards.hypothesis: Only an empty or corrupted chunk result may fail the Stage-B validity gate.
cards.deployment_scope: all Stage-A release candidates
negative_conditions: short nonempty chunk is retained
cards.coverage_impact: none; invalid chunk rejection has no representative family
cards.rollback_behavior: retain rejected chunk by disabling the specific hard gate

cards.hypothesis: A losslessly normalized exact duplicate adds no distinct learning signal once a stable representative exists.
cards.deployment_scope: all Stage-A release candidates
negative_conditions: lossless normalized digest has not appeared
cards.coverage_impact: the first stable representative is retained for every exact duplicate family
cards.rollback_behavior: retain rejected chunk by disabling the specific hard gate

cards.hypothesis: A symmetric lexical overlap family can retain one stable representative.
cards.deployment_scope: chunks meeting declared lexical-token and overlap conditions
negative_conditions: pair overlap is below threshold or either chunk lacks minimum lexical tokens
cards.coverage_impact: one representative per declared stratum is retained
cards.rollback_behavior: retain all family members by disabling near-duplicate compaction

cards.hypothesis: A source record explicitly marked generated and non-editable is a removable structural artifact.
cards.deployment_scope: records with both explicit generated and non-editable in-text evidence
negative_conditions: generated declaration is absent
non-editable declaration is absent
source-declared generation alone is insufficient
cards.coverage_impact: no target-mix restoration
cards.rollback_behavior: retain source record by disabling this artifact rule

cards.hypothesis: A self-contained chunk containing only explicit license/comment text has no independent learnable payload.
cards.deployment_scope: all text-only Stage-C chunks
negative_conditions: chunk contains executable or explanatory payload
license marker is absent
cards.coverage_impact: none
cards.rollback_behavior: retain chunk by disabling this rule

cards.hypothesis: Only an import/export-only scaffold family identical after trailing-whitespace normalization can retain one stable representative.
cards.deployment_scope: text-only chunks satisfying the scaffold syntax condition and sharing a signature that preserves comments, indentation, and case
negative_conditions: chunk contains substantive implementation
comment text, indentation, or case differs
normalized scaffold signature differs
cards.coverage_impact: one stable representative per trailing-whitespace-equivalent scaffold family is retained
cards.rollback_behavior: retain all scaffold family members by disabling this rule

cards.hypothesis: Every redundancy removal must retain a linked representative in the curated pool; unexplained loss makes materialization invalid even though Coverage never ranks or deletes records.
cards.deployment_scope: runtime materialization invariant with veto-only authority
negative_conditions: metadata strata, source identity, language, content type, or composition would alter selection
cards.coverage_impact: reports missing representative links and zero-survivor violations and fails materialization; never ranks, deletes, restores by quota, or targets a composition
cards.rollback_behavior: abort materialization when a required representative link is absent or not curated

cards.hypothesis: A complete HTML shell with no visible lexical payload is a removable non-payload artifact.
cards.deployment_scope: complete HTML documents with no visible lexical payload after tags are removed
negative_conditions: HTML with visible text, script, style, image, or embedded content remains
cards.coverage_impact: whole-chunk removal is allowed only after explicit empty-shell evidence
cards.rollback_behavior: retain the chunk by disabling this rule

cards.hypothesis: An explicit prefix license header is separable non-payload when the residual independently satisfies the Stage-B payload boundary.
cards.deployment_scope: Hard development profile only; text-only chunks with an explicit license marker
negative_conditions: ordinary documentation, a non-prefix header, or copyright attribution without an explicit license marker remains
a license-only residual remains unmodified
cards.coverage_impact: rewrites a span only; the residual chunk must pass the declared Stage-B boundary
cards.rollback_behavior: disable the Hard development profile and preserve the original chunk

cards.hypothesis: A self-contained explicit license comment block is separable non-payload when the residual independently satisfies the Stage-B payload boundary.
cards.deployment_scope: Hard development profile only; text-only chunks with an explicit license marker
negative_conditions: ordinary comments, API documentation, and code-bearing comment blocks remain
a residual below the Stage-B boundary remains unmodified
cards.coverage_impact: rewrites a span only; the residual chunk must pass the declared Stage-B boundary
cards.rollback_behavior: disable the Hard development profile and preserve the original chunk

cards.hypothesis: A long exact normalized repeated paragraph is separable non-payload only from nonrepresentative chunks with an independently valid residual.
cards.deployment_scope: Hard development profile only; Stage-B pass chunks
negative_conditions: short shared phrases, near matches, independent test matrices, and chunks without residual payload remain
cards.coverage_impact: links every removed span to a stable representative occurrence and retains every rewritten chunk
cards.rollback_behavior: disable the Hard development profile and preserve the original chunk

cards.hypothesis: A contiguous run of closed-set web controls or URL-only directory lines is separable non-payload when a substantive residual independently passes the Stage-B boundary.
cards.deployment_scope: candidate-only text-structural development materialization
negative_conditions: privacy or cookie terms inside explanatory prose remain
reference lists with titles or explanations remain
dialogue-like speaker turns remain
a chunk without a Validity-compliant residual remains unchanged
cards.coverage_impact: rewrites only identified spans, preserves the chunk, and requires a residual-payload check before materialization
cards.rollback_behavior: do not materialize the candidate plan; preserve original chunk text

cards.hypothesis: A whole chunk containing only a closed error marker and at least three closed navigation labels has no independent training payload.
cards.deployment_scope: development-only text-structural candidate
negative_conditions: error explanations remain
code and logs containing error markers remain
any line outside the closed error/navigation sets retains the chunk
cards.coverage_impact: whole-chunk rejection is candidate-only and must report zero-survivor effects before promotion
cards.rollback_behavior: disable the candidate key and retain the original chunk

cards.hypothesis: A whole chunk containing at least five standalone URL lines and no other payload is a candidate non-payload directory artifact.
cards.deployment_scope: development-only text-structural candidate
negative_conditions: annotated references remain
mixed prose and URL content remains
fewer than five standalone URL lines remain
cards.coverage_impact: whole-chunk rejection is candidate-only and must report zero-survivor effects before promotion
cards.rollback_behavior: disable the candidate key and retain the original chunk

cards.hypothesis: Redundancy must be represented as typed relations because exact equivalence, small substitutions, containment, repeated spans, semantic neighbors, and complementary records do not share one deletion authority.
cards.decision_unit: candidate pair, typed relation edge, and equivalence family
cards.deployment_scope: candidate-only cross-domain relation construction after Validity
negative_conditions: short changed records are never near-substitute families
trailing whitespace, indentation, internal spacing, and line-structure changes are not formatting equivalence
numeric constants, operators, negation, answer labels, API signatures, named entities, and code identifiers are substantive differences
near, containment, repeated-span, and semantic edges do not receive record-deletion authority
independent implementations and complementary explanations remain
cards.coverage_impact: only exact and narrowly bounded formatting equivalence form safe families; final representative choice is deferred to Stage C Quality and Coverage
cards.rollback_behavior: discard the candidate graph and preserve the active structural runtime unchanged

cards.hypothesis: Only a later exact occurrence of a closed-set navigation-marker block within one chunk is a candidate redundant span when the residual independently passes the Stage-B boundary.
cards.decision_unit: later exact repeated contiguous text span
cards.deployment_scope: candidate-only text-structural development materialization
negative_conditions: repeated document headings remain
tables, code, quotations, references, and test matrices remain
a first occurrence remains
a chunk without a Validity-compliant residual remains unchanged
a label outside the closed navigation-marker set remains
cards.coverage_impact: rewrites only a later repeated span, preserves the first occurrence and whole chunk, and requires a residual-payload check before materialization
cards.rollback_behavior: do not materialize the candidate plan; preserve original chunk text

cards.hypothesis: A chunk composed entirely of explicit cookie-control UI markers has no independent textual learning payload.
cards.deployment_scope: chunks with four or more nonblank lines, each an explicit cookie-control marker
negative_conditions: explanatory prose, substantive text, or any unrecognized line remains
cards.coverage_impact: whole-chunk removal is allowed only after explicit all-lines UI evidence
cards.rollback_behavior: retain the chunk by disabling this rule
